requirement: A demo whose public name does not reach tracy-web is not reported live: the install fails ADDRESS_SHADOWED

oracle.ref: PR #1383 (fix); fix evidence: 15/10/2026: business-joomla.tracy.ai and business-emdash.tracy.ai answered Cloudflare 502 on every path (stale DNS + tunnel 91b557ed rules outranking *.tracy.ai) while the /ops reinstall of tracy-business/j6 reported the demo live
oracle.invariant: S1: view.error is ADDRESS_SHADOWED, state failed, no update sets publish = 'published', the job is written failed at step address and failureReason reads the 'does not reach Tracy' message. S2: the demo is marked live. S3: 200, body equal to the token, cache-control no-store.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)
